high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from the Forbes India social media post, dated one day ago. The text overlay on the image reads: "To accomplish great things we must not only act, but also dream; not only plan, but also believe." — Anatole France The background of the photo shows a library setting with bookshelves filled with books, suggesting an intellectual or academic environment.
